summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by PayPay Corp, a Japanese foreign private issuer, to furnish the notice of its 8th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM). The filing includes the meeting notice as Exhibit 99.1 along with standard signatures. This is a routine corporate housekeeping item, not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven components. The filing merely complies with SEC periodic reporting requirements for foreign issuers.
